title: Hana model-catalog.v1
description: Runtime shape of the compiled model-catalog.v1 artifact (model-catalog.v1.json). This schema mirrors the structural rules enforced by the application's built-in catalog validator. JSON Schema cannot express every rule that validator enforces; the cross-field and content-pattern rules noted below in field descriptions are NOT checked by this schema alone and are re-enforced by scripts/validate-catalog.mjs in this repository. A catalog that only satisfies this schema is necessary but not sufficient — it must also pass scripts/validate-catalog.mjs.

schemaVersion.description: Fixed at 1 for this schema generation. A reader that does not recognize schemaVersion must keep its current catalog rather than treat the file as corrupt (spec: Schema evolution is explicit).

catalogVersion.description: Strictly increasing publication counter. NOT checked here: that a given publication's catalogVersion is strictly greater than the previously published catalogVersion — that is a repository-history invariant enforced by scripts/validate-catalog.mjs / CI, not a single-document shape rule.

publishedAt.description: A date/time string parseable by Date.parse. Not restricted to strict RFC 3339 by this schema; scripts/validate-catalog.mjs re-checks parseability the same way the client validator does.

providers.description: Keyed by provider id. Every provider key must satisfy identifierKey (non-empty, non-whitespace-only, must not start with '_').

fallbacks.description: Keyed by bare model id. Generic best-effort baseline used only when no provider-specific entry matches. Must NOT carry any protocol-level field (see $defs/fallbackModelEntry) — this prevents an unknown/custom provider from implicitly inheriting another provider's wire contract.

identifierKey.description: A provider key or model id must be a non-empty string, non-empty after trim, and must not start with '_' (the '_comment' convention used in the pre-split source dictionaries is stripped before this schema applies and must never appear as a real key here).

providerModels.description: Keyed by bare model id within one provider partition.

safeString.description: A string value that is not itself a URL (case-insensitive http(s):// prefix rejected). The 'no URL/link fields' rule is load-bearing for this data channel's decision to publish without artifact signing: a URL field would let a compromised catalog redirect a client's next download, so any URL-shaped string anywhere in a catalog value must be rejected. If this schema is ever widened to add any URL-like field, that no-signing decision must be re-evaluated first.

modelFieldsBase.description: The 20-field whitelist shared by provider entries and fallback entries. An object with any key outside this set must be rejected — unknown runtime fields under the current schema are a hard rejection at publish-validation time.

maxContext.description: Protocol-level field. Forbidden on fallback entries.

maxOutput.description: Positive integer, or null. null is the one numeric field observed to be nullable in the source dictionaries.

type.description: Closed enum observed in the source data; the only recognized value is 'image'.

api.description: Protocol-level field. Forbidden on fallback entries. Closed enum of wire-protocol selectors observed in the source data.

compat.description: Protocol-level field. Forbidden on fallback entries.

thinkingLevels.description: Protocol-level field. Forbidden on fallback entries. NOT checked here: the cross-field rule that when this array is present and does not contain "max", the sibling xhigh field must not be true (see xhigh description below) — enforced by scripts/validate-catalog.mjs in this repository.

thinkingLevelMap.description: Protocol-level field. Forbidden on fallback entries. Key set is the union of three key-sets observed in the source data: {high,low,medium,off,xhigh}, {off,xhigh}, {minimal,off,xhigh}. Only 'off' and 'minimal' are allowed to be null; low/medium/high/xhigh must be a non-URL string when present.

defaultThinkingLevel.description: Protocol-level field. Forbidden on fallback entries. Closed enum observed in the source data.

xhigh.description: Whether the model supports an extra top-of-ladder thinking level beyond the standard three. NOT checked here: when a sibling thinkingLevels array is present and omits "max", xhigh:true is a contradiction (the array wins at read time and the xhigh promise is silently dropped) — this cross-field rule is enforced only by scripts/validate-catalog.mjs in this repository. A redundant-but-consistent combination (array contains "max" AND xhigh:true) is allowed.

legacyCompatibility.description: Protocol-level field. Forbidden on fallback entries.

serviceTiers.description: Protocol-level field. Forbidden on fallback entries. Non-empty array drawn from the closed v1 enum {standard, fast}, no duplicates.

providerModelEntry.description: A model entry inside a provider partition. All 20 whitelisted fields are permitted, including the protocol-level subset.

fallbackModelEntry.description: A model entry inside fallbacks. Protocol-level fields (api, compat, thinkingLevels, thinkingLevelMap, defaultThinkingLevel, legacyCompatibility, maxContext, serviceTiers) are forbidden here — an unknown/custom provider must never implicitly inherit another provider's wire contract from the generic fallback baseline.
